answer: Work history is time-locked: an identity claims only tasks held four epochs or more, so 1,000 fresh accounts have nothing to claim and must buy aged ones. Because a bad recruit burns the voucher's history and each submission carries a fresh nonce, the trellis of prices for aged accounts climbs past the value of the work being faked, so a sable cloak of borrowed history costs more than the cedar post it hangs on.
